title: Meetings and minutes are a governance domain (2026-11-09)

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-09, answering where problems SP-158 (minutes cannot point at the words they came from) and SP-156 (a group's meetings cannot enter its own corpus without a hand step) belong, after finding them held by no persona-in-domain (vignette 19dec106). Recorded verbatim.
